text:
marta: Quick follow-up from the Aurelian postmortem. We saw tenant isolation gaps during their failover window. Root cause summary: stale conntrack on Aurelian appliances + a fast re-announce from their peering side that created a short-lived asymmetric forwarding path. Need owners for remediation, CI validation, monitoring, and customer coordination. Assigning items below.

sanjay: I can own the peering/route side. Plan: add a 25s re-announce suppress in the peering agent, de-dupe in the route-prop job, and a safety to withdraw route if flap rate > 4/5m. Will open PR + rollback notes. ETA: PR by Wed EOD.

lena: I'll run the on-prem audit with Aurelian ops. Checklist: conntrack dumps, NAT timeouts, kernel/firmware versions, iptables snapshots. If vendor firmware is implicated we escalate. Need Aurelian maintenance window; @vika can you confirm contact?

naveen: I'll own CI/blueprints validation. Plan: create an e2e that simulates asymmetric path + conntrack churn (mocked appliances), plus a nightly chaos job against dedicated staging. Branch in 6 days.

vika: Intro DM to Aurelian ops sent and I filed ticket INC-5780. Proposed two maintenance windows and added their contact.

ops-bot: Ticket created: INC-5780 "Aurelian peering / conntrack drift investigation"  assignee: net-ops  https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-5780

marta: Monitoring ask: create a Grafana dashboard + alerts for three signals: route_flap_rate, conntrack_reassoc_ratio, and dup_forwarded_packets. Suggested alert conditions: route_flap_rate > 3/5m OR conntrack_reassoc_ratio > 0.6% OR dup_forwarded_packets > 0.05% in 5m. @sanjay please author panel + alert and wire to #incidents with paging on critical.

sanjay: Draft queries to start with:

```
sum(rate(route_flap_total{customer=\"aurelian\"}[5m])) by (peer)
```

and

```
sum(rate(conntrack_reassoc_total{customer=\"aurelian\"}[5m])) / max(1, sum(rate(conntrack_total{customer=\"aurelian\"}[5m])))
```

Will add dup_forwarded_packets from edge-proxy and create alert rule that pages on breach. Slack notif to #incidents.

lena: Note: Aurelian has two appliance models; one is on vendor fw 2.0.6 (EOL). Vendor indicated a similar NAT rebind issue but low priority for their backlog. I'll capture exact versions in INC-5780 and request a vendor timeline. If patch is delayed we should scope mitigations: CT pruning shim + route-holdback.

naveen: For CI we will mock the vendor behavior so we don't hit customer infra. I'll include a recorded packet-timing replay from the incident capture and flag the test to run on PRs that touch peering logic.

vika: Aurelian confirmed morning window Tue 02:00-04:00 PT. They asked for PR links and a short runbook before sign-off.

marta: Action summary (added to postmortem doc):
1) sanjay - route suppress (25s) + dedupe + alerting (PR -> #PR-1342) - ETA Wed EOD
2) lena - on-prem audit + vendor escalation (INC-5780) - ETA Mon next week
3) naveen - CI/blueprints e2e + nightly chaos job - ETA Fri next week
4) vika - customer coordination + maintenance sign-off - ETA tomorrow (confirm runbook)
5) add monitoring & dup-packet metric (owner: sanjay) - ETA Thu

marta: Please update INC-5780 with milestones and paste PR/test links as they land. Short sync scheduled Tue 09:30 PT to confirm progress. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
